authorizedScope: Separate supplementary comparison, never a replacement for the failed fixed 30-second stress protocol
scenario: Complete one navigation, drag, edit or resize before the next; continuous scrolling remains a fixed 30-second gesture; delayed chat overlaps a fixed task-switch sequence and an explicitly accounted backend wait

originalStressStatus.attributionLimits: 100-row scroll has an actual late input. Reading inputs finished within 30 seconds. The 300-row 5150.640ms presentation gap lies mainly before next beforeSynchronizing (5118.734ms); existing timestamps do not identify GPU work, driver waiting, timer origin or a particular function. The 100-row closure gap lacks boundary entry/exit timestamps to distinguish delayed tick entry from shutdown work.
originalStressStatus.retryPolicy: No repeat-until-pass, added time, relaxed deadline or spliced passing history subsets

fixture.effects: Existing full-DPR shaders/material parameters and active authorized Native Live2D model; no quality reduction
fixture.safety: Registered isolated encrypted data; one owned loopback mock child; original source, binary, signature, dependency and owned-process checks

fixedWork.deadlineScope: Predispatch gate and active transaction have separate deadlines. Phase deadline includes every gate, active segment and pause; history deadline also includes setup and idle phases.

accounting.mainCadence: Only full frameSwapped intervals contained within an active transaction segment; no trimming or artificial subdivision
accounting.boundaryCadence: Retain entire entry/exit crossing intervals separately, including long intervals; same physical interval can have both tags
accounting.activeCpu: Sum getrusage RUSAGE_SELF deltas over the same active segments
alsoRequired: whole phase wall duration and CPU
accounting.metricLimits: Presentation cadence is neither GPU time nor input-to-display latency. Whole cost and crossing intervals remain visible even if main cadence improves. Idle states cannot dilute active metrics.

comparison.relativeNoise: Maximum absolute pair difference divided by the smaller valid positive value across independent full A/A suites
comparison.rateNoise: Maximum absolute pair difference across independent full A/A suites
comparison.boundaryRegressionPolicy: Entry/exit crossing P95 and over50 ratio use the same relative/rate allowances, or the measured A/A noise when larger; a regression vetoes an accepted gain. Whole phase cost remains separately visible.
comparison.environmentPolicy: Require AC power and low-power mode off; reject explicit recorded CPU or scheduler limits below 100. Preserve unknown/unmeasured thermal state without claiming identical chip temperature.
comparison.rejection: Insufficient records, contract/source mismatch, environment anomaly, uncertain gain or quality regression cannot be silently omitted or repaired by changing this contract after the run
comparison.cpuConclusion: CPU efficiency gains are recorded independently and never described as frame-rate gains
comparison.scopeLimit: Even a passing supplementary comparison does not pass the original stress performance plan

visualAndFunctional.unchangedPassedFunctionChecks: Do not repeat the full previous acceptance merely because strict performance calibration failed
remaining: Matched A/B visual states and actual text
